blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Poland Poland Platnicki

- Group dealing in collection, cultivation and trade of anomalous mushrooms and derivatives there-of, such as psycho-active substances and bio-weapons. - Founded around 1800. - Organizes the Mushroom Contest every three months, searching for the one who can collect the most mushrooms, winners get a job offer from the Association. - Wary of the Foundation. - Don’t care about what is done with their goods.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Poland Worldwide, mainly Europe Zygard and EvilAngel413

- Company leasing/selling anomalous equipment of demonic origin. - Their products range from personal use applications and vehicles to weapons based on energy harvested from demons. - Hunter Industries have multiple laboratories and factories, some of them are located in the Demonic Layer of Reality. - They will sell their products to anyone. - Willing to cooperate with the Foundation.
Autonomic Recon Group with Undefined Specialization Inc. (A.R.G.U.S. Inc.)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: United States Unknown, but sell worldwide Fs-ior

- Company leasing/selling well-trained soldiers and/or anomalous heavy military equipment, training militias and producing potent psychotropic drugs and other stimulants. - Works undercover as a private security company, mostly undertaking recon tasks and guerrilla operations, but also part of larger conflicts. - Often in conflict with governments. - Products help users to gain the upper-hand in battle, but also cripple them. - The company's history and personal details of their clients is unknown. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Have moral standards, but money is more important most of the time.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Poland Poland Zygard

- Cult that organizes concerts of anomalous nature. - Founded in the 20th century by Antoni Bukowski. - Worships the composer Fryderyk Chopin by composing new pieces. Calls upon him once a year. - Whoever gets closest to Chopin's style will receive "a gift from God" in the form of incurable tuberculosis. - Wary of the Foundation. - Takes casualties into account as part of their worship.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Poland Poland wanna-amigo

- Organization producing and selling anomalous everyday objects, furniture and kitchen appliances for example. - Products are often dangerous, despite being intended to improve life, either because of unreliability or malfunction. - Organizational structure is unknown. - Hides from the Foundation. - Apparently does not hold the wellbeing of their customers in high regard.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown Poland Silnik

- An organization pretending to be a civil law company founded in the early 21st century. Deals in production, modification and trade of anomalous means of transport. - Probably works in order to raise funds for a project unknown by the Foundation. - It was confirmed that every transaction carried out by the organization must be confirmed by a contract if it involves persons from outside the organization. It is unknown why. - On motoring forums, the group has achieved the status of an urban legend, which increases the range of influence it has. It is possible that they find buyers for their products through these forums. - The existence of only two members of the group is officially known, but the existence of a network that helps in conducting its operation is not excluded. - There is a fanatical group that believes that the company's works are gifts from the gods and the creators themselves are the saviors of this world.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown Mostly Poland, but also other European countries Unknown

- A group completely unknown to the Foundation. - Carried out several hacker attacks on the Foundation database. - Unfriendly towards the Foundation. - In reality, WWW is a network of people unified under the goal of disconnecting our universe from the rest of the multiverse.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Austria The entire world Bonneneige

- Company that produces musical anomalies. - Leader is related to the Leader of Knowing Publishing. - Created a music school and lets the students perform with its anomalies. - Staff is immune to the effects of music- and sound-based anomalies. - Will try to attack anyone who steals their creations or destroys stolen objects. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Has mostly normal moral standards, but if they get stolen from, the thief becomes a target for elimination.

entries.title: Association of Black Magic Power Users

profileContent.title: Association of Black Magic Power Users

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Thailand Thailand Bonneneige

- Group of people that practice black magic. - Members come from all over the world and carry anomalous objects with them. - Because of the diverse origins of members, the magic practices and anomalies get mixed together to create something new. - Tried to purchase anomalies from the Foundation and then attempted to raid it when it declined. - Anomalies of this group can be absolutely anything. - Hostile towards the Foundation, still tries occasionally to raid it. - Don't care about the wellbeing of others.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Thailand Thailand DrSSS

- Organization formed by human anomalies hunted and/or exploited by other organizations, including the Foundation. - Only wishes for a life in peace. - Lives in the "Hidden City", deep in the jungle, where those who do not abide by the rules are banished. - Will become the enemy of everyone who disturbs their peace. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Don't want to harm anyone who isn't their enemy.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: A parallel world called KP@PU-5 The entire world DrSSS

- Producer of the anomalous printing media. - Distribution method of its products is unknown. - Author names and addresses on books are fake. - Products can be ordered from leaflets or are placed in public areas. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Doesn't care about harm done to its readers.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Thailand Many east-asian countries Agent Arms

- Large group of civilians with the purpose of destroying anomalies or, occasionally, taking advantage of it - Several large civilian protest groups across Southeast Asia. - Stated to become more violent since 1990. - Try to destroy various objects, often leading to incidents and tragedies. - Possesses many anomalies stolen from the Foundation. - Hostile towards the Foundation, since it rejected their purchasing attempts of anomalies. - Their goal is to keep people safe, but they aren't very successful in doing it.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Great Britain The entire world DrSSS
- Not much is known about this individual. - Benefactor of the Foundation. - Owns a lot of real estate related to SCP objects. - Tries to help the Foundation. - His morals are unknown.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan bamboon

- Group of sushi chefs who deal with anomalous food. - All participate in the traditional anomalous art of Sushiblade . - Due to their use of unorthodox food ingredients, methods, and techniques, they’re branded as ‘heretics’, and have fallen to ‘the Dark Side’. - Leader of the group is known as Yami, a trained sushi chef who seeks to topple the traditional values of Sushiblade. - Dark Sushi has several groups of command, such as the Dark Sushi Lords, and the Four Dark Sushi Knives. - Will do anything to win Sushiblade battles, and develop more powerful Sushiblades.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown Japan Tyobi

- Corporation composed of several organizations working together. - Manufactures, distributes and sells anomalous goods, mainly adult toys. - Goal is to grant their clients the utmost pleasure possible. - Believed to be in contact with extraterrestrial entities. - The stance towards the Foundation is positive, but have been known to behave otherwise to please customers and stockholders. - Questionable work ethics.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Tokyo, Japan Mainly Japan VideoGameMonkeyMONO

- Restaurant that offers anomalous meals. - Meals are catered towards individual clients, and refuse to market to the general public. - Meals are made to “offer the client the most meaningful meal experience, transcending taste”. - The waiter that serves the food is the most well known member of the group. The chef might be visible at times. - Hide from the Foundation, moving their location constantly.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire world yosh0123

- Confederation of island states residing in an still accessible alternate dimension - Was originally colonized around the 14th to the 16th century by people fleeing from the influence of the great powers. - Safeguards its territory with the use of anomalous artifacts known as relics, said to have originated from a civilization known as Thule 2 . - Several anomalous entities originating from this country have been sighted in our reality. - Does what he does out of fun. - The stance towards the Foundation is unknown. - Tries to prevent suffering and casualties if possible.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire world Unknown

- individual/group imitating the activities of other groups of interest. - Most objects created by him cause harm to the user. - Does what he does out of fun. - Doesn't care about the Foundation. - The wellbeing of others is of no concern to him.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown Unknown Unknown

- Company specializing in anomalous custom items. - Products are designed to fulfill the customers wishes or pave them a path for the future. - Similar to a devils deal, its services come with a price, for example memories, body parts, belongings, etc. - Is mainly advertised through local newspapers and Internet advertisements, though individual sales were documented. - Stance towards the Foundation is unknown. - Seems not to mind the harm their anomalies cause.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Alternate Universe Japan DocRone

- Extradimensional Group with no known structure. - Sometimes send anomalies into our universe, accompanied by messages. - Anomalies are of random nature with no known pattern. - Stance towards the Foundation is unknown, Drunkness Street never directly interacts with it. - Seems not to mind the harm their anomalies cause.
Eden leap Mutual Aid (ElMA)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Alternate Dimensions Alternate Dimensions indonootoko , Mitan , snoj and stengan774

- Religious group that travels through dimensions and timelines.. - They have a loose organization and do not have any dangerous cult practices, other than ‘leaping’. - Believe in the goddess ElMA, spoken about by the Founder of the group, who would travel through dimensions unwittingly. - They believe traveling through dimensions cleanses the soul from both virtues and sins, and often leave their teachings and illustrations of ElMA in the worlds they visit. - They possess knowledge and technology of many eras, times and dimensions. - On friendly terms with many organizations. The Foundation is wary of their dimension-hopping technology.
Gogyō-Kessha 3
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Kyoto, Japan Japan wobe does not match any existing user name

- Group that wishes to rid Japan of anomalous influence. - Was born during the Heian period (794-1185) as part of the Bureau of Onmyō. - Became members of the Global Occult Coalition’s (GOC) Council of 108 following the end of World War II. - Specialize in thaumaturgical techniques, especially Onmyōdō-based arts. - Hostile towards the Foundation and other paranormal organizations.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan shinjimao and blackey

- Organization that utilizes anomalous tools to save lives and maintain peace. - Three types of employees: Field agents, engineers and administrators. - Field agents often dress and behave like Tokusatsu-film superheroes. - Field agents often worsen situations they’re involved in, and tend to resort to vigilante justice. - Because of this, it’s believed the organization’s goals might not be for the sake of helping people.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire world furabbit

- Metaphysical conglomeration of ‘concepts of animals’. - Unknown scale, scope, and organization. - Contact people using ‘positive imagery’, ‘dream logic’, ‘conceptual animals that are not human’, etc. - They are a friendly group, but have no understanding of reason, values, society, and so forth. - Are on friendly terms with the Foundation due to their approach and relative ease in containment.

entries.title: Imperial Japanese Army Special Medical Force

profileContent.title: Imperial Japanese Army Special Medical Force

blocks.text: Imperial Japanese Army Special Medical Force (a.k.a. "Unit Negative Numbers")
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Imperial Japan Imperial Japan tokage-otoko

- Imperial Japanese Army unit, which researched the occult and technology, founded in 1937 under the Army and Shūshū-In. - A common name and its codename was "Unit Negative Numbers". - Had three divisions, "Tsuchigumo", "Jofuku" and "Tatara" which conducted research mainly on magic, life science and mechanical engineering respectively. - Purpose of the organization was to research and produce weapons by a combination of magic and science. - Some weapons were used in the war, but they were never mass produced. - In 1945, the organization was dismantled and its remains taken in by the Foundation. - Was hostile towards the Foundation. - Had no qualms about abducting, torturing and killing anyone it needed to.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan tsucchii0301

- Family name with unclear relationship, all bearing the surname “Isanagi” - “Isanagi” people are often in places of power within Groups of Interest, and possess anomalous powers. - All have plant-themed names. - “Isanagi” used to be a clan with strong political influence over the GoI Shūshū-In.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan azuki0912

- Association selling anomalous products, most of which have a relation to beauty. - Wide repertoire of selling methods, including door to door sales and advertisements in department stores. - The most products are for women and come in a pink package. - Main salesperson is known as "Salesperson Miyako", and appears to be several people under the same name. - Stance towards the Foundation is unknown, having never interacted directly with it. - Seems not to care about harm to their customers, given the side effects of her products.

entries.title: Japanese Anomalous Groups Peace and Amity Treaty Organization

profileContent.title: Japanese Anomalous Groups Peace and Amity Treaty Organization

blocks.text: Japanese Anomalous Groups Peace and Amity Treaty Organization (JACPATO)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown Japan seafield13

- Legal organization tasked with the detection of independent anomalous activity of government bodies and mediation between affiliated organizations in case of disputes. - Created in 1959 after the Foundation and the Global Occult Coalition signed a treaty with the Japanese Government. - Seems to withhold several anomalies from the Foundation. - Leaks Foundation intel to the government of Japan. - As one of the main organisations to join, the Foundation exerts a huge influence on the Organization. - Was founded to prevent casualties.

entries.title: Japan Organisms Improvement and Creation Laboratory

profileContent.title: Japan Organisms Improvement and Creation Laboratory

blocks.text: Japan Organisms Improvement and Creation Laboratory (JOICL)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan mizuno

- Organization creating anomalous life forms, such as animals, plants and objects which behave like creatures. - Almost all creatures manifest anomalous properties or additional functions. - Rarely sells their creations. - Purpose of the organization is unknown. - Hide from the Foundation. - Not restricted by standard ethics.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan carbon13 , Sansyo-do-Zansyo , Mishary and RainyRaven

- Family clan that excelled at ‘talking’. - They used to mediate wars between other clans and groups, and received support from many. - They had no military prowess, and didn’t resort to anomalous countermeasures. - They aided the weak and the marginalized, incorporating them into the clan. - Greatly downsized in recent times, only a few descendants still around.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Tohoku region, Japan Tohoku region, Japan Unknown

- Small construction company specializing in anomalous architecture. - Although adhering to wishes of its clients, buildings tend to have harmful effects. - Most of it remains a mystery but ties to the Oni of Japanese folklore could be discerned. - Stance towards the Foundation is unknown. - Doesn't care about potentially harmful properties of their buildings, unknown if that's because of malice or a differing value system.
Koigarezaki Shimbun 4
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Alternate Dimension The entire world Unknown

- News agency disseminating information about ongoing events in the world of the anomalous. - Reports largely over web news. - Resides in LoI-0850, an alternate dimension inaccessible by the Foundation. - Has several ex-members of other GoI in its ranks, allowing them to create anomalous objects. - Given the bias and occasional fabrication of facts in their articles, probably hostile towards the Foundation. - Do not care about the harm their articles might indirectly cause.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Many Worlds Many Worlds santou , usubaorigeki , kyougoku08 and home-watch

- Common name for several mutual aid communities. - Each community is composed of life-forms that come from different worlds. - The goal of each community is to return to their homeworld or find another that is apt for them. - They appear to not have any leadership, and are loosely organized.. - Each community and individual have different opinions about the Foundation, and relationships range from hostile to friendly.
Mujin-Getsudō-Shū 5
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan The entire world WagnasCousin

- Group of mercenaries that exchange information for money. - Born from the ‘shinobi’ group, the group was formed in order to keep the traditional ninja ways alive. - Utilize traditional shinobi and ninja techniques since ancient times. - Believed to also utilize anomalous technology. - Often clashes with the Foundation and other Groups of Interest.
Research Projects Agency for the Marriage With Anime Characters (PAMWAC)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Mainly Japan Unknown

- Loose group based around an online web forum accessed through the dark web. - Users create and exchange supernatural information in order to fulfill their desires. - Interest are mainly within the Otaku subculture (Anime, manga, video games, etc.) - Originally created as ‘Approaches to marry your ideal wife’ (RYOMEA), the site had this goal in mind, but has expanded since then. - Users have also been found using platforms outside of the forum, such as Discord. - It’s known that some users have leaked Foundation information into the forums.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan The entire world dr_toraya

- Organizations consisting of POI called Rokumi Saiga (犀賀六巳) and his followers. - Saiga has conducted activities in many parallel universes to save said universes. - Brought items from his journeys to other universes. - Tries to hide himself from all other groups of interest. - Hides from the Foundation. - Given that they try to save the humans from as many universes as they can, the Saiga factions are prone to cause harm to the people of our universe as "necessary sacrifice".
Sekiryu 6 Club
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Kyoto, Japan Kyoto, Japan Unknown

- Secret society active since the mid-19th century. - Indulge in cannibalism, calling human flesh "Pomegranate". - Only 10 members can exist at each given time. - Organizational identity beyond interactions is not clear. - Involved with other Groups of Interest. - Wary of the Foundation. - Tend to abduct and eat people.
Shūshū-In 7
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan Kwana

- Organization collecting anomalies for containment. - Often used non-scientific methods utilizing the augury, magic and religion for containment, mainly Shintō 8 and Shugendō 9 . - The Foundation took the organization and most of its objects in and took over their containment procedures. - Some radicals remained with some artifacts and try to get Shūshū-In back to its former glory. - Radicals are hostile towards the Foundation. - Try to keep innocents safe.

entries.title: Special Affairs Division, Public Security Bureau of Metropolitan Police Department

profileContent.title: Special Affairs Division, Public Security Bureau of Metropolitan Police Department

blocks.text: Special Affairs Division, Public Security Bureau of Metropolitan Police Department (SAD)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan Unknown

- Undercover investigation agency within the Metropolitan Police Department, tasked with processing abnormal phenomena and paranormal crimes. - Under the control of the Special Affairs Investigation Bureau of National Police Agency, which is in turn a member of the Japanese Anomalous Groups Peace and Amity Treaty Organization, so it is influenced by Japanese politics. - Tasked with fighting other GoIs and anomalies and protecting the public. - The job is made difficult by overbearing bureaucracy and mediocre equipment. - Cooperates with the Foundation. - As a police force it is tasked with saving lives and property.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Japan Japan Unknown

- Manufacture many anomalous artifacts with unknown operating principles, tailored to a specific problem stated by the customer. - Organization structure is unknown. - Distributes anomalies to independent parties. - Hides from the Foundation. - Moral standards are unknown.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire World Unknown

- Conglomerate staffed by numerous anomalous entities hailing from legend, myth and folklore - President self-identifies as the Greek god "Hermes", the vice-president is known as the Egyptian deity "Thoth". - Provides a large assortment of services, among them translation, gastronomy, logistics, housing, and others, mostly used by themselves. - Communication occurs in several extinct or obscure languages. - Friendly towards the Foundation. - So far, there have been no casualties attributed to this group.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Tōno City, Iwate Prefecture, Japan Tōno City, Iwate Prefecture, Japan Unknown

- Paranormal Free Port accessed from the Kitakami Mountains in Tōno City. - Sanctuary is inhabited by Yōkai, humans, mixed-bloods, and maintained by Mountain Deities. - During World War II, deserters from the IJAMEA’s Yōkai Battalion migrated into the area. - Mostly an isolated community, the Sanctuary began opening in 1989, and has been developing as a community since.

entries.title: Anomalous Materials Information and Security System

profileContent.title: Anomalous Materials Information and Security System

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creators:: Italy Italy Riko-based Lifeform , Dr Pistos & Dr Pisy

- Military research and development, military coordination, intelligence and policing organization in the anomalous field. - Founded by the Republic in 1949 with the support of the GOC and of the U.S. as a government agency to aid the resolution of anomalous interministerial events and against Soviet GoIs. - Got severely downsized in 1996 because of the end of the Cold War . - Its main purpose is to ensure the Country's safety from the anomalous. - Collaborates with the Foundation nowadays, but it still allows itself to sanction it when it takes things too far.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: State of the Church Vatican City, Italy, and most Catholic countries MrFizban

- Secret religious order created by Pope Leo I in AD 454. - Based on Catholicism, led by the Pope and a few chosen Cardinals. - Divides anomalies in two categories: "Angelic", which are kept as relics, and "Demonic", which are either contained or destroyed. - Collected a large number of anomalies during the Crusades and the Spanish colonization of America.

entries.title: Cult of the Great Eye of the Mediterranean

profileContent.title: Cult of the Great Eye of the Mediterranean

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Probably Greece The Mediterranean Sea Generale Radahn

- Religious sect active since at least the 9th century BC. - Worships the Great Eye, with the majority of its more powerful members being a species of sea-dwelling humanoid. - Adept at controlling creatures of the sea and a wide variety of esoteric powers. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Not above hurting and killing innocents.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Italy Italy DrGraph & Mr Abadede

- Organization formed by members of the ROYAL INSTITVTE OF ITALIAN ANOMALIES still loyal to Fascism after its fall. - Aims to restore Fascism and create an Italian Empire. - Led by the Dictator , an individual with anomalous abilities. - Possesses advanced technology, used to create biological and bio mechanical weapons. - Hostile towards the Foundation - Lacks the resources to launch a frontal assault on either the Foundation or the Italian state. - Has an unknown number of sites in Italy, with an estimated 2500 members. - Not concerned with wounding and even killing innocents as long as it furthers its goals.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Italy Italy Heck_Tech

- Pharmaceutical industry that researches and produces anomalous drugs and biological weapons. - Founded in the 80s of the 20th century. - Inspired by the Imperial Roman Cult of Febris, they found the tablets written by the Cult, obtaining the thaumaturgical knowledge of the Goddess, to which they implemented modern biotechnological knowledge. - Led by the CEO, the actual owner of the tablets, which claims to receive Febris' will through them. - Very cautious towards the Foundation, they are trying to enter into commercial agreements with more powerful GoIs to achieve more power.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Florence Italy (headquarters), operates worldwide Naikos

- Private organization founded by Lorenzo the Magnificent in 1484. - Creates and collects anomalous artworks such as paintings and statues. - Has a large number of sites in most countries; each one is led by a " Tutore ". - The leader of the Medicean Academy is the " Curatore " and operates from the Palazzo Medici Riccardi, which hides a vast underground museum.
Ordo Iani 12
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Roman Empire Italy MrFizban

- Ancient group created by Emperor Titus to study anomalous entities and events. - Active since AD 79. - Based on Roman religion and philosophy. - Currently has only a few sites, with less than 400 members. - Allies of the Foundation, carry out joint operations. - Tries to avoid any casualties if possible.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Kingdom of Italy Italy and its colonies DrGraph & Mr Abadede

- Division of the Kingdom of Italy's intelligence agencies that studied and contained anomalies. - Active from 1871 to 1946, when it became part of the SCP Foundation. - A splinter group still loyal to Fascism fled and later became the Fascist Council of the Occult . - Tested anomalous weapons during military operations, especially after the rise of Fascism.

entries.title: Serenissimo Colejo degli Estri e dei Maùchi del Comùn

profileContent.title: Serenissimo Colejo degli Estri e dei Maùchi del Comùn

blocks.text: Serenissimo Colejo degli Estri e dei Maùchi del Comùn 13
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Most Serene Republic of Venice Venice and its commercial routes DrAlberts

- Secret organization of the Most Serene Republic of Venice, caused by the necessity of mitigating the impact of the use of anomalies from the Republic's rival powers. - Active from the first half of the ninth century to the Treaty of Campo Formio in 1797, when it was dismantled. - Controlled a trading system of anomalies that weren't considered dangerous by Venice or weren't usable for its purposes. - Was founded with two main objectives: The Most Serene Republic of Venice's independence and its enrichment through the business of anomalous artifacts.
Political Organisation of the Rukh “Angriff” (P.O.R.A.)
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Ukraine Ukraine, CIS, Russian-occupied territories, Canada and Eastern Europe Comrade Xander

- Nationalistic Eurocentric liberal-right terrorist organisation. - Extremely antagonistic to everything and everyone they consider Russian or pro-Russian. - Hosts members of different GoIs, the ideological prerequisite being the only one. - Divided into two parts: Rukh "Angriff", a radical liberal right organisation, performing public and non-anomalous activities and acting as P.O.R.A.’s public front, proxy, foot soldiers and recruitment initiative; and the Political Organisation itself, acting as the Rukh’s elite and secretive leadership. Knowledge of the anomalous is usually only provided to P.O.R.A. members, although select Angriff operatives receive limited information on a need-to-know basis. - Funds come from crowdfunding, pro-Ukrainian oligarchs and entrepreneurs, the Democratic Party of the USA, George Soros, extortion of “ideologically compromised” businesses and minor operations on the anomalous black market. - Ties with Yushchenko and Poroshenko governments and affiliates, employed by them for black operations. - Anomalies used are either easy to control or have predictable results. - Own production capacities are mostly limited to anart, as well as simple thaumaturgical and Sarkic rituals; most are procured or received from third parties.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown the entire world murzei_chaos

- Doctrine that advocates for the futility of existence, and as a direct consequence, the eradication of the human population. - Uses and creates various anomalies, in order to cause a K-Class End-of-the-World Scenario. - Have a knack for weaponizing harmless anomalies. - There is a theory that Annihilism might have an anomalous memetic nature. - Because of its goals, it is at odds with almost all other GoI. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Tries to cause the maximum number of casualties.

entries.title: Department of Abnormal Threats of the Security Service of Ukraine

profileContent.title: Department of Abnormal Threats of the Security Service of Ukraine

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Ukraine Ukraine murzei_chaos

- Ukrainian institution for the collection, research and elimination of the anomalous. - Abbreviated DAT SSU. - Relatively incompetent due to a lack of funds and experience, still sometimes faster to respond than other anomalous groups. - Tries to avoid engagement with highly dangerous anomalies. Has arrangements with the Foundation to research and monitor safe and moderately dangerous anomalies - Hostile towards anomalous groups who threaten Ukraine, but neutral or even cooperative towards all others. - Allied with the Foundation. - Tries to avoid harming civilians.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire World murzei_chaos

- Group of sapient machines, calling themselves "Perfecties". - In the past the Troupe held concerts to encourage people and to help the lower classes - Can give machines sapience using the "Spirit of the Machine". - Members believe that machines are in today’s society the most oppressed class and that humans are in the way of cultural and scientific progress, justifying their eradication. - Call humans "meaties" and cyborgs "half-measures" - Create sentient anomalies that look like surreal versions of normal machines and perform unusual and unexpected functions. - Hostile towards the Foundation, as well as all other anomalous groups comprised of humans. - Wants to eradicate all of humanity.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown the entire world murzei_chaos

- Religion believing in the Shining Lord, a deity who can influence events on the entire world together with its angels. - Anomalies of this group mostly manipulate probability or create "magic" and "miracles". These have drawbacks and require various offerings, such as animal sacrifices, or sacrifices of more abstract things like personality traits. - Anomalies are procured from other worlds. - Hostile towards other religious groups. - Hostile towards the Foundation, although respectful. - Not completely amoral, but human life can be sacrificed to achieve their goals.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire World Unknown

- Enterprise specializing in espionage regarding anomalous matters. - Only goal is the gathering and trading of information. - Does not use any sort of anomalous phenomena to accomplish goals. - Indifferent towards the Foundation, but classified as hostile because of its work. - Sacrifices human life for the sake of profit.

entries.title: The Brazilian Superintendence of the Paranormal

profileContent.title: The Brazilian Superintendence of the Paranormal

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Brazil Brazil slashannemoo (contact)

- Secret military intelligence governmental institution in Brazil, founded in 1965. - Founded during the Brazilian Military Government to compete with the Foundation. - Had a similar command structure. - Annexed to the Lusophone Foundation in 1989. - Studied the anomalous on the territory of Brazil. - Sabotaged and interrupted operations of the Foundation until its acquisition in 1992. - Had no qualms about abducting, torturing and killing innocents.

entries.title: The Hunting Club of Fauna and Flora

profileContent.title: The Hunting Club of Fauna and Flora

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Portugal Portugal and other lusophone countries slashannemoo (contact)

- Association founded in 1920, comprised of affluent and influential individuals that hunt anomalies for sport. - Have access to paratech weaponry, but not a big military power. - Association similar to a Guild, with a Huntmaster elected by Associates. - Studied the anomalous on the territory of Brazil. - Neutral towards the Foundation. - Their hunting sport does extend to anomalous humans, but they leave civilians alone.

entries.title: The Order of the Tower and Valor

profileContent.title: The Order of the Tower and Valor

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Portugal The entire World, but mostly Europe slashannemoo (contact)

- Agnostic military organization, created in 1570. - Collects relics associated with religious cultures of non-anomalous, and anomalous theologies. - Inner structure works according to the Code of Three Virtues: Respect, Tenacity, and Compassion. - Can use lesser thaumaturgical abilities through a substance known as "Varlour". - Governed by a Grand-Master, and a Chancellor elected by a Council of Comendadores . - Neutral towards the Foundation. - Also hurts civilians in their pursuit of adding to their collection.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Portugal The entire World, but mostly in underdeveloped countries slashannemoo (contact)

- Paramilitary organisation, founded in 1942. - Collects anomalous objects to gain more influence around the globe through the value and capabilities of said objects. - May be involved with organized crime. - Inner organisation is unknown. - Hostile towards the Foundation. - Not above putting innocents in harm's way or even killing them.

entries.title: The Scientific Academy of the Anomalous

profileContent.title: The Scientific Academy of the Anomalous

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Portugal Portugal and its satellite states in Africa slashannemoo (contact)

- Scientific-research institution for the anomalous in Portugal, founded in 1875. - Formerly known as the Royal Portuguese Institution for the Paranormal. - Restructured during the Estado Novo government of Salazar. - Educational center to teach new researchers the knowledge of the anomalous. - Incorporated into the Lusophone Foundation in 1992. - Was governed by an Administrative Director, Rectors and Department Heads. - Neutral towards the Foundation. - Never directly hurt civilians, but their technology was used to.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Portugal Portugal and Brazil slashannemoo & Taoca

- Society of individuals that utilizing thaumaturgy in conjunction with technological implements - Founded during the First Industrial Revolution. - Use their knowledge to create paratechnology. - Their inventions are for member-use only. - Existed since the First Industrial Revolution. - Governed by a superintendent Council. - Amicable towards the Foundation. - Have no desire to hurt normal people or to use them for experiments.
Origin: Active in: Creator:: Vietnam, 10th century Indochina and southern China KH Nam

- Religious order and criminal organization formed during the late Đinh Dynasty era. - Originally a form of belief practiced by some clans of sorcerers. - Became extreme overtime, was purged and scattered by the Bureau of Anomaly Surveillance. - Eventually regained traction during the Nguyễn dynasty and French colonization era. - Is highly stratified and discreet, with nonanomalous criminal activities conducted by low-ranking members outside of the Veil. - Beliefs revolve around the worship of plants, "the natural world", and the Wood Deity. - Members only consume meat and consider plant-based foods as blasphemous. - Hates microorganisms, animals with flesh, especially inorganic life forms and artificial intelligence. - Opposes industrialization and modernization, believes in the return of their Wood Deity. - Hostile towards the Foundation: + A direct enemy of the Spiritual Division ( Site-75-VN ), many armed conflicts have happened. + Once even managed to breach and sabotage a Foundation site ( Site-29-VN ).

blocks.text: Origin: Active in: Creator:: Unknown The entire world Dr Ore & slashannemoo

- Coalition of telepathically linked people, members can spread this property by being near unlinked people for a long time. - Telepathic link allows the instantaneous transfer of knowledge between individuals. - Has members in almost every anomalous Group in existence, continues to convert more members to gain access to their knowledge. - Anomalies created by them usually incorporate knowledge and techniques from multiple GoI. - Aims for scientific advancement in all fields through the use of the anomalous. - The telepathic link between all members creates a gestalt intelligence that secretly controls the entire organization, without making itself known. This intelligence can infect new victims in emergencies. - This gestalt intelligence also brainwashes people, rewriting their entire personality if their views don't align with the Hive, or if they become aware of the Hive's existence. - Many members working as infiltrators unknowingly have the secret objective of allowing the gestalt intelligence to infect more and more people around them. - Irritated by the Foundation since it was discovered by it in 2012. - Tries to prevent deaths and injuries, but will resort to violence if placed under enough pressure.
